title: The Old Map
logline: In his Bristol bindery, Arthur Penhaligon asks his apprentice to bring the old map: he promised they would find the bridge before dark.

brief.text: In his Bristol bindery, Arthur Penhaligon asks his apprentice to bring the old map: he promised they would find the bridge before dark.

scenes.title: The map

lines.text: Bring me the old map, Paul. I promised we would find the bridge before dark.

beats.action: At his workbench Arthur looks up and asks his apprentice, off-screen, for the old map.

scenes.purpose: Arthur asks for the old map; a close look at him speaking.

shots.purpose: Arthur asks for the old map
shots.action: Medium close-up of Arthur at his workbench, face turned three-quarters toward the camera; he looks up from the book press and speaks his line clearly to his apprentice, who is off-screen beside the camera.

dialogue.text: Bring me the old map, Paul. I promised we would find the bridge before dark.
